messages:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick sync — we have NorthCloud + EdgeWorks co-sell tracks kicking next quarter. Need alignment on account gating, lead ownership, and joint-announcement timing. Can we confirm ROE today? 

Mike (Sales Engineering): +1. Main ask: which accounts are reserved for SI-led demos vs Redwood-led? Also need clear escalation path if SI requests feature dev. 

Sarah (SI Ops): For onboarding, we want account mapping to be deterministic. Proposal: SI claims when they have >20% ACV relationship and logged engagement in SFDC. Otherwise Redwood owns initial intake. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Jon (Partner Eng): That threshold seems fine but add a carveout for named strategic accounts (list in sheet). Also recommend a "30-day qualification" window — if SI hasn't engaged in 30 days, ownership reverts. 

Tess (Field Sales): Need clarity on lead credit / commission. Can legal/sales ops confirm? We can't promise splits without official ROE. 

David (Legal): We'll need a short amendment template for co-sell pipeline sharing and NDA for customer references if doing joint announcement. I can draft a one-pager. 

Elaine (Product): From product side — if SI requests custom integration, dev timeline should be triaged through SR planning. We'll accept small adapter work (<2 sprint effort) with partner funding; bigger work needs product review. 

Priya (Partnerships): OK actionables so far:
- David draft one-pager NDA + co-sell amendment (due Thu)
- Jon update mapping sheet with 'strategic accounts' carveout (due Wed)
- Mike + Sarah finalize 30-day qualification rule and update playbook (due Fri)
- Tess to loop Sales Ops on commission rules (ASAP)

Mike (Sales Engineering): Added a tiny mapping snippet for SFDC tags:
``
SI_Lead_Source = 'SI_Referral' | 'SI_Owned'
Account_Owner = 'redwood' | 'northcloud' | 'edgeworks' | 'shared'
Claim_Reason = 'ACV_pct' | 'Named_Strategic' | '30_day_activity'
```
Use those tags for automation. 

Sarah (SI Ops): I'll test an automation rule: if Claim_Reason = Named_Strategic -> route to partner queue; else if SI_Referral and ACV_pct >=20 -> assign to SI partner queue; else to Redwood intake. Will post test logs. 

Jon (Partner Eng): Also we need a joint announcement checklist:
- confirm logos and legal clearance
- finalize short joint press blurb
- publish marketplace listing (if applicable)
- schedule joint webinar 2-4 weeks after GA

Priya (Partnerships): Can someone take point on Marketplace listing dependency? EdgeWorks wants their HW bundle visible before joint announcement. 

Elaine (Product): I'll coordinate with eng to tag the build for marketplace packaging. ETA 10 business days if no changes. 

Tess (Field Sales): I'll draft a short customer-facing one-liner for the announcement and share. 

David (Legal): Draft uploaded: http://confluence.internal/legal/si-co-sell-onepager (placeholder link) — feedback welcome. 

Jon (Partner Eng): Quick test output from automation (Sarah's queue): "2178001248 - account XYZ assigned to partner queue (EdgeWorks) - reason=ACV_pct=27%" 

Priya (Partnerships): Great. Final Q: if both Redwood AE and SI engage simultaneously, do we default to 'shared' ownership? 

Mike (Sales Engineering): Recommend shared for first 60 days; then if one side demonstrates >30% engagement or closed-won, assign permanent owner. 

Sarah (SI Ops): We'll implement shared lane with dual-notify in SFDC. 

Priya (Partnerships): Thanks team — I'll consolidate into the playbook doc and send a calendar sync for Friday 11am to finalize. :calendar: 

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: "SI Co-sell Playbook Finalize" Fri 11:00-11:30 (link)

Tess (Field Sales): :thumbsup: 

Mike (Sales Engineering): closing loop — added rules to the playbook draft: http://docs.redwood/partnerships/si-cosell-playbook (draft). Please review before Fri.
